options.content: Values are **model-based estimates** from the World Bank Real-Time Prices (RTFP) dataset, not observed prices. Rows flagged as spatially interpolated are less reliable. County values are **unweighted means of market values**. Source: https://microdata.worldbank.org/catalog/6167 - check the dataset's terms of use for citation requirements.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_key::timestamp AS time, avg_close AS "Maize (avg close)"
FROM mart.national_month
WHERE product_code = 'maize_fao'
  AND date_key >= (SELECT max(date_key) - interval '24 months' FROM mart.national_month)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT source_version AS "Release", loaded_at AS "Loaded at", loaded_rows AS "Rows",
       validation_status AS "Validation"
FROM metadata.lineage ORDER BY loaded_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Q2: Food price index inflation by county (latest month)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT county_name AS "County", round(avg_inflation_pct::numeric, 2) AS "Food price index inflation",
       round(avg_yoy_calc_pct::numeric, 2) AS "YoY (calculated)", n_markets AS "Markets"
FROM mart.county_month
WHERE product_code = 'food_price_index'
  AND date_key = (SELECT max(date_key) FROM mart.county_month)
ORDER BY avg_inflation_pct DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Q3: ${product} - average close by county (latest month)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT county_name AS "County", round(avg_close::numeric, 2) AS "Avg close"
FROM mart.county_month
WHERE product_code = '${product}'
  AND date_key = (SELECT max(date_key) FROM mart.county_month)
ORDER BY avg_close DESC

SELECT county_name AS "County", round(share_interpolated::numeric, 2) AS "Share interpolated",
       round(avg_trust::numeric, 3) AS "Avg trust", n_markets AS "Markets"
FROM mart.county_month
WHERE product_code = 'food_price_index'
  AND date_key = (SELECT max(date_key) FROM mart.county_month)
ORDER BY share_interpolated DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Q5: Markets with thinnest recent coverage

targets.rawSql:
SELECT market_name AS "Market", county_name AS "County", n_months AS "Months",
       last_month AS "Last month", round(data_coverage_recent::numeric, 2) AS "Recent coverage",
       round(share_interpolated::numeric, 2) AS "Share interpolated"
FROM mart.market_coverage
ORDER BY data_coverage_recent ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 50
